title: Into The Wilderness
description: While lying in bed next to your beautiful girlfriend Boof, you suddenly are awakened by a loud buzzing sound. Boof is gone, and Fairies are everywhere, you set out and follow her screams.

title: The Desert after Dinner
description: After the storm you find yourself stranded on a beach. Ahead you see a volcanic Island. You decide to see what's ahead, but wait, the fairies have followed you here too...

title: Barren BURR!
description: After your crash landing you find yourself against a frozen tundra. It seems to go on forever, nothing seems to live. But wait, the fairies followed you here too....DIE FAIRIES!

title: Da Fairy Kingdom
description: You find yourself climbing a stairway into the clouds, ascending further and further, finally you realize you are heading right into the heart of the fairy kingdom. GO GET EM'
